comment:
**Make the invalid-route test detect a validation regression.**

`report()` supplies 12 samples, but each expectation declares one route and requires six. The sample-count check returns `route-matrix-mismatch` even if the new route validator accepts either invalid route. Test the shared schema directly for these boundaries, or use an assertion that cannot pass because of the unrelated sample-count mismatch. As per path instructions, “Check for adequate test coverage, edge cases, and proper assertions.”
